record.question: Who is the minister in-charge of Public Health Engineering in Mizoram?
record.explanation: Answer D: Tawnluia. In the December 2019 MPSC Horticulture exam period, Deputy Chief Minister Tawnluia held the Public Health Engineering portfolio; an official PHED publication bears his title as Minister of PHED. Reference: https://phed.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/19c865ba3d2610538630e914b90a66b9/e-book-2019-20-phed.pdf; https://mizoramassembly.in/storage/proceedings/September2024/Xw9fUVMI05djTrvmmCNS.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
